title: docs: the dashboards and analytics pages teach dataset members with synonyms and a description
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6947282338, gap 2); the filer did not re-read the code behind it.

## Why

Two documentation pages still show a measure with a name and a label only. An author who follows them publishes exactly the dataset the new advisory warns about.

## Evidence

- Per the report: `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` and `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` teach bare members.

## Scope

- Both pages show `synonyms` and `description` on the members they teach, with one sentence on what each is for and that one word names one member.

## Done when

- Neither page has an example the `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` rule would flag.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34718.
